# DRYmedic

> > DRYmedic provides 24/7 emergency restoration services for water, fire, mold, and storm damage across residential and commercial properties.

DRYmedic is a national disaster recovery and property restoration company offering comprehensive damage mitigation and restoration services. With a franchise network spanning multiple states and OSHA-certified professionals, the company specializes in emergency response, insurance claims support, and complete property reconstruction.
